The '''2014–15 Tahiti Ligue 1''' was the 68th season of the [[Tahiti Ligue 1]] organized by the [[Tahitian Football Federation]] since its establishment in 1948.<ref>[https://www.rsssf.org/tablest/tahiti2015.html RSSSF.com]</ref>
